def: The system around a base model that decides how it plans, calls tools, manages context, stores artifacts and evaluates results.
Choosing and maintaining what goes into the model's context window: instructions, examples, notes and retrieved facts.
A method that treats context as an evolving playbook of itemised bullets, updated incrementally by generation, reflection and curation.
The tendency of a model that rewrites a context to drop domain detail in favour of a shorter summary.
The gradual loss of detail when a context is rewritten again and again.
A system whose proposer reads the code, scores and traces of all earlier candidate harnesses through a file system and writes better ones.
A seed improver program that uses a language model to improve code, and is then run on its own code to produce a better improver.
The average utility an improver reaches across a set of tasks, used to score the improver itself.
A coding agent that keeps an archive of its own versions, edits its own code with a language model and validates each change empirically.
The set of files and processes a proposer may change; the scorer and verifier should lie outside it.
